quests.title: Guild Clerk Esther - Meet Scared Poppuri (Key Quest 1)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
steps: Speak to Guild Clerk Esther inside Megalopolis Guild Office.
Exit Megalopolis Square to the southeast into Southeast Forest and talk to Scared Poppuri.

quests.title: Scared Poppuri - Scared Poppuri's Concern (Key Quest 2)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
quests.prereqText: Level 30+, Sandman - The Miracle of Sand (and Guild Clerk Esther - Meet Scared Poppuri)
steps: Speak to Scared Poppuri in Southeast Forest.
Hunt Kokebi (Lv.39) in Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave (or Southeast Forest) to obtain 1x Toy Box.
Return 1x Toy Box to Scared Poppuri.

source.map: Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave / Southeast Forest

quests.title: Scared Poppuri - Look for Toys (Key Quest 3)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
steps: Speak to Scared Poppuri in Southeast Forest.
Hunt Simbatta (Lv.42, Southeast Forest) for 1x Squeaky Hammer.
Hunt Sppo (Lv.46, Southeast Forest) for 1x Exchange Diary.
Hunt Moss Moth (Lv.48, Poppuri Dungeon - Moss/Rainbow Cave) for 1x Teddy Bear.
Hunt Larva (Lv.52, Poppuri Dungeon - Spore/Root Cave) for 1x Robot Model Kit.
Bring all 4 toys back to Scared Poppuri.

source.map: Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave / Rainbow Cave
Poppuri Dungeon - Spore Cave / Root Cave

items: Keeps the 4 Toys for Artisan Poppuri - Fix Toys

quests.title: Vagabond Eloy - Eloy's Skin Care [Instant Adhesive #1]
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
steps: Speak to Vagabond Eloy in Southeast Forest.
Hunt Pochi (Lv.35) in Southwest Forest to collect 3x Multi-Vitamin per cycle (15x total for 5 cycles).
Turn in 3x Multi-Vitamin to Vagabond Eloy 5 times to receive 1x Instant Adhesive on Cycle 5.

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x 500 Galder Coupon | Cycle 5: 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x 500 Galder Coupon

quests.title: Poppuri - Poppuri's Request [Instant Adhesive #2]
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
steps: Speak to Poppuri in Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave.
Drill in Poppuri Dungeon Caves (Depth 20~30m, Land) to collect 3x Poppuri Whistle per cycle (15x total for 5 cycles).
Turn in 3x Poppuri Whistle per cycle for 5 cycles to receive 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Peridot Gemstone on Cycle 5.

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x Poppuri Bean | Cycle 5: 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Peridot Gemstone

quests.title: Poppuri - Get the Special Whistle [Instant Adhesive #3]
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
steps: Speak to Poppuri in Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave after completing Poppuri's Request.
Hunt Koom (Lv.55) in Poppuri Dungeon - Root Cave / Slide Cave to collect 1x Special Whistle per cycle (5x total for 5 cycles).
Turn in 1x Special Whistle per cycle for 5 cycles to receive 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Peridot Gemstone on Cycle 5.

source.map: Poppuri Dungeon - Root Cave / Slide Cave

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x Poppuri Bean | Cycle 5: 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Peridot Gemstone

quests.title: Hungry Poppuri - Poppuri's Special Snack [Instant Adhesive #4]
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
quests.prereqText: Level 30+ (Have at least 1x Red Petal in inventory)
steps: Drill inside Poppuri Dungeon Caves (Depth 20~30m, Land) for 3x Red Petal per cycle (15x total for 5 cycles).
Turn them in to Hungry Poppuri in Poppuri Dungeon - Rainbow Cave 5 times to receive 1x Instant Adhesive on Cycle 5.

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x Poppuri Bean | Cycle 5: 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Poppuri Bean

quests.title: Artisan Poppuri - Artisan Poppuri That Makes Alarm Clocks (Poppuri's Alarm Clock - 10 Cycles)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
steps: Speak to Artisan Poppuri at Gate of Poppuri Dungeon.
Hunt Kokebi (Lv.39) in Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave (or Southeast Forest) for 1x Talky Mushroom per cycle (10x total for 10 cycles).
Drill in Poppuri Dungeon Caves (Depth 20~30m, Land) for 1x Battery Lasting Long per cycle (10x total for 10 cycles).
Turn in 1x Talky Mushroom + 1x Battery Lasting Long per cycle across 10 cycles to earn 6x Super Alarm Clock (Cycles 2, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10) for Blue Muffler Poppuri!

source.map: Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave / Southeast Forest

quests.notes: Each cycle gives 80,738 Base EXP (121,107 EXP on 1.5x rate). Save all 6x Super Alarm Clock: 5x are turned in to Blue Muffler Poppuri (I Don't Like Vampire Bats), and 1x must stay in your inventory to start Purifying Poppuri Dungeon!

quests.title: Blue Muffler Poppuri - I Don't Like Vampire Bats [Instant Adhesive #5]
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
quests.prereqText: Level 30+, Have Super Alarm Clock in inventory (from Artisan Poppuri)
steps: Speak to Blue Muffler Poppuri in Poppuri Dungeon - Spore Cave (with Super Alarm Clock in your inventory).
Hunt Turvy (Lv.45) in Poppuri Dungeon - Spore Cave to collect 3x Turvy's Tooth per cycle (15x total for 5 cycles).
Turn in 1x Super Alarm Clock + 3x Turvy's Tooth per cycle for 5 cycles to receive 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Peridot Gemstone on Cycle 5.

source.from: Reward from Artisan Poppuri That Makes Alarm Clocks (Cycles 2, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10)

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x Poppuri Bean | Cycle 5: 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Peridot Gemstone

quests.title: Blue Muffler Poppuri - Purifying Poppuri Dungeon [Instant Adhesive #6]
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
quests.prereqText: Blue Muffler Poppuri - I Don't Like Vampire Bats + 1x Super Alarm Clock in inventory
steps: Keep the 6th Super Alarm Clock (from Cycle 10 of Artisan Poppuri) in your inventory and speak to Blue Muffler Poppuri in Poppuri Dungeon - Spore Cave.
Hunt Larva (Lv.52) in Poppuri Dungeon - Spore Cave / Root Cave to collect 3x Poisonous Moss per cycle (15x total for 5 cycles).
Turn in 3x Poisonous Moss per cycle for 5 cycles to receive 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Peridot Gemstone on Cycle 5.

source.map: Poppuri Dungeon - Spore Cave / Root Cave

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x Poppuri Bean | Cycle 5: 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Peridot Gemstone

quests.title: Indiana John - Indiana John at Poppuri Dungeon (1) [Instant Adhesive #7]
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
steps: Speak to Indiana John in Poppuri Dungeon - Root Cave.
Drill in Poppuri Dungeon Caves (Depth 20~30m, Land) for 1x Amber per cycle (5x total) and hunt Sppo (Lv.46) in Southeast Forest for 1x Gold Powder per cycle (5x total).
Turn in 1x Amber + 1x Gold Powder per cycle for 5 cycles to receive 1x Instant Adhesive on Cycle 5.

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x Poppuri Bean | Cycle 5: 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Poppuri Bean

quests.title: Indiana John - Indiana John at Poppuri Dungeon (2) [Instant Adhesive #8]
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
quests.prereqText: Level 35+, Indiana John - Indiana John at Poppuri Dungeon (1)
steps: Speak to Indiana John in Poppuri Dungeon - Root Cave after completing Part (1).

Collect 1x Peridot Gemstone (drilled in Poppuri Dungeon Caves or earned from Poppuri / Artisan Poppuri / Blue Muffler Poppuri quests) and drill 1x Moss Water (Depth 20~30m, Land in Poppuri Dungeon Caves) per cycle (5x each total).
Turn in 1x Peridot Gemstone + 1x Moss Water per cycle for 5 cycles to receive 1x Instant Adhesive on Cycle 5.

source.from: Drill Depth 20~30m (Land) OR Reward from Poppuri Quests

items: Cycles 1-4: 1x Poppuri Bean | Cycle 5: 1x Instant Adhesive + 1x Poppuri Bean

quests.title: Artisan Poppuri - Fix Toys (Key Quest 4)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
quests.prereqText: Scared Poppuri - Look for Toys + 4x Instant Adhesive
steps: Speak to Artisan Poppuri at Gate of Poppuri Dungeon.

Hand over the 4 broken toys (Squeaky Hammer, Exchange Diary, Teddy Bear, Robot Model Kit) and 4x Instant Adhesive (earned from any 4 of the 8 Instant Adhesive quests above) to receive 1x Mended Toy Box.

source.from: Complete any 4 of the 8 Instant Adhesive quests above

quests.title: Scared Poppuri - Poppuri Redemption (Key Quest 5)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
quests.location: Southeast Forest -> Poppuri Dungeon - Slide Cave
steps: Speak to Scared Poppuri in Southeast Forest with the Mended Toy Box.
Navigate to Poppuri Dungeon - Slide Cave and deliver 1x Mended Toy Box to Stern Poppuri to complete Poppuri Redemption!

source.from: Reward from Artisan Poppuri - Fix Toys

quests.title: Stern Poppuri - Journey to Caballa Relics (Key Finale)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis & Poppuri Dungeon - Key Quests & Instant Adhesives
quests.location: Poppuri Dungeon - Slide Cave -> Gate of Caballa Relics
steps: Speak to Stern Poppuri in Poppuri Dungeon - Slide Cave to accept 'Journey to Caballa Relics'.
Travel to Gate of Caballa Relics and speak to Wise Hen.

quests.title: Indiana John - Old Man's Dream (Unlocks Surprise Spots!)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Enlightenment
steps: Speak to Indiana John in Southeast Forest to receive the Treasure Map Use Guide and permanently unlock Surprise Spot drilling & Explorer Reina / Driller King Marky Treasure Map quests!

items: 1x Treasure Map Use Guide (Unlocks Surprise Spots)

quests.title: Monkey T - Loyal Monkey T (3)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Enlightenment
steps: Speak to Monkey T in Southwest Forest.
Hunt Forest Tickler (Lv.44) in Southwest Forest or Southeast Forest for 5x Energy Grass per cycle.

quests.title: Card Girl - Megalopolis Card Girl Quests (1 to 5)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Enlightenment
steps: Quest 1 (Lv.35+): Turn in 1x Sppo Card (from Sppo Lv.46, Southeast Forest) -> 245,428 TM EXP + 2x Arcana Smart Card.
Quest 2 (Lv.40+): Turn in 1x Forest Mantis Card (from Forest Mantis Lv.50, Southwest Forest) -> 366,066 TM EXP + 2x Arcana Smart Card.
Quest 3 (Lv.42+): Turn in 1x Koom Card (from Koom Lv.55, Poppuri Dungeon - Root/Slide Cave) -> 419,480 TM EXP + 4x Arcana Smart Card.
Quest 4 (Lv.42+): Turn in 1x Queen Yamu Card (from Green Chipmunk Lv.39, Southwest Forest) -> 419,480 TM EXP + 5x Arcana Smart Card.
Quest 5 (Lv.42+): Turn in 1x Kokebi Card (from Kokebi Lv.39, Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave) -> 419,480 TM EXP + 6x Arcana Smart Card.

source.map: Poppuri Dungeon - Root Cave / Slide Cave

quests.title: Hunter Yuri - South East Forest Hunter Girl & Hunt the Feisty Koom
quests.chapter: Megalopolis - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Enlightenment
quests.location: Path to Desert Beach & Southeast Forest
steps: Southeast Forest (Lv.28+): Speak to Hunter Yuri and hunt 1x Feisty Koom (Lv.60) in 5 min in Poppuri Dungeon - Moss Cave -> 19,264 Base / 8,722 TM EXP + 500 Galder Coupon + 2,000 Galder.
Path to Desert Beach (Lv.30+): Speak to Hunter Yuri and hunt 15x Pink Chipmunk (Lv.33) in 15 min on Path to Desert Beach -> 35,125 Base / 12,499 TM EXP + Hunter Girl's Special Gift.

quests.title: Love Hunter Robin - Southwest Forest & Poppuri Dungeon Monster Quests
quests.chapter: Megalopolis - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Enlightenment
quests.location: Southwest Forest & Gate of Poppuri Dungeon
steps: Southwest Forest (5 Cycles per bracket): Lv.25-30: 30x Pochi (20m) | Lv.31-40: 30x Forest Wasp (20m) | Lv.41+: 30x Forest Mantis (20m).
Gate of Poppuri Dungeon (Infinite Cycles): Lv.30-39: 15x Kokebi (15m) | Lv.40-45: 15x Turvy (15m) | Lv.46-50: 15x Moss Moth (15m) | Lv.51+: 15x Koom (15m, rewards 267,241 TM EXP + Poppuri Bean!).

objectives.monster: Pochi / Forest Wasp / Forest Mantis / Kokebi / Turvy / Moss Moth / Koom

quests.title: Star Gazer Stella - Daily Quest - Megalopolis
quests.chapter: Megalopolis - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Enlightenment
steps: Speak to Star Gazer Stella in Megalopolis Square.
Hunt regional monsters in Desert Beach, Caballa Relics, or Oops Wharf for 2x Shtella's Profile.
Return 2x Shtella's Profile to Star Gazer Stella.

source.map: Desert Beach / Caballa Relics / Oops Wharf

items: Choice: 2x 500 Galder Coupon / 5x Pink Potion B / 5x Blue Potion B

quests.title: Fairy Nono & 4 Arbiters - Card Identification & Trickster Crest (Enlightenment)
quests.chapter: Megalopolis - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily & Enlightenment
quests.npc: Fairy Nono & Arbiters of Courage, Wisdom, Dreams, Love
quests.location: Poppuri Dungeon - Mysterious Space (via Curious Poppuri in Rainbow Cave)
steps: Step 1: Speak to Curious Poppuri in Poppuri Dungeon - Rainbow Cave to enter Mysterious Space, then talk to Fairy Nono.
Step 2 (Arbiter of Courage): Turn in 1x Arcana Brave Card and defeat 1x Guardian of the Brave (Lv.80) -> 1x Courage Crest.
Step 3 (Arbiter of Wisdom): Turn in 1x Arcana Smart Card and defeat 1x Wise Sphinx (Lv.80) -> 1x Wisdom Crest.
Step 4 (Arbiter of Dreams): Turn in 1x Arcana Dream Card and defeat 1x Guardian of Dreams (Lv.80) -> 1x Dream Crest.
Step 5 (Arbiter of Love): Turn in 1x Arcana Love Card and defeat 1x Loving Lucia (Lv.80) -> 1x Love Crest.

Step 6: Bring all 4 Crests to Fairy Nono for 1x Trickster Crest, then give 1x Trickster Crest + 5x Harkon Shard to Artisan Poppuri in Moss Cave ('Giant's Poppuri Treasure') for the Trickster Certificate, and return to Fairy Nono to learn Card Identification!

source.from: Reward from Caballa Relics Card Girl Quests
Reward from Desert Beach / Megalopolis Card Girl Quests
source.map: Gate of Desert Beach / Southeast Forest

source.from: Reward from Oops Wharf Card Girl Quests
Reward from Ghost Blue Card Girl Quests
Opened from Harkon Heirloom (Path to Mermaid Palace 1 & 2)

objectives.monster: Guardian of the Brave / Wise Sphinx / Guardian of Dreams / Loving Lucia
